page.content:
Bactrian camel trains that made the desert legs possible.

How Camel caravans connects

  • Location: Overland Silk Road — Bactrian caravans were the transport of the desert legs.
  • Faction: Sogdians — Sogdian firms organized many of the Central Asian camel caravans.

What is Camel caravans?

Camel caravans — two-humped Bactrians on the cold deserts — carried silk, jade, and bullion between oases. The animal, not a paved road, is the overland technology.

Key threads lead to Overland Silk Road and Sogdians.
